disclaimer: Engineering and data-governance review. The software records evidence and policy status; it must not purport to certify legal rights.
reviewer: Claude Opus 5.5 coding agent, drafted on operator instruction. The operator confirms or rejects this review when recording the admission decision.

dataset_license_metadata.where: dataset card YAML front matter and repository metadata at the pinned revision
dataset_license_metadata.covers: Essential AI's contributions: the database, its annotations and taxonomy labels

attribution_obligations.essential_web: Attribute Essential-Web v1.0 under ODC-By and cite arXiv:2506.14111 in any public use or redistribution of the database or of works produced from it, to the extent ODC-By requires.
attribution_obligations.common_crawl: Abide by the Common Crawl Terms of Use. No separate attribution clause was found on the terms page; Common Crawl is named as the upstream source in the attribution plan regardless.

underlying_content_caveat.statement: Essential AI does not alter the license of any underlying data. ODC-By applies to Essential AI's contributions, not to each crawled page. Individual pages keep whatever copyright, terms of service or other rights their owners hold.
underlying_content_caveat.consequence: Unknown upstream rights stay unknown (C04). This review does not resolve them.

chain: DCLM pool: 89 resiliparse-extracted snapshots, CC-MAIN-2013-20 to CC-MAIN-2022-49
12 additional snapshots, CC-MAIN-2023-06 to CC-MAIN-2024-38 (101 in total)
global hash deduplication, per-snapshot MinHash LSH deduplication, quality annotation and filtering, taxonomy labeling
Essential-Web v1.0 at the pinned revision
XLM frozen B-normal selector over eai_taxonomy and quality_signals
provenance.fineweb_lineage: Essential-Web is not FineWeb or FineWeb-Edu and is not on the direct-source denylist. All of them derive from Common Crawl, so indirect document overlap with other Common-Crawl-derived sources cannot be excluded; C05 cross-source deduplication applies.
provenance.xlm_scope: 23,200 files in eight crawl strata (inventory digest 4bbd5517e760971405d9aed56bba5b84877a6325d10f5a10a05b50f5a8d763d8), not all 101 snapshots

privacy_and_third_party_risk.statement: Web-crawled text can contain personal information, copyrighted material and otherwise restricted content. The dataset card documents no removal of personal information.
privacy_and_third_party_risk.project_controls: C03 cleaning and basic secret/PII detection are not a certification that the corpus is free of personal information.

intended_use.use: pretraining research corpus for XLM Mix-01 under the strict_research usage policy

mitigation: Canonical documents keep source id, pinned revision, source file and row locator, plus the upstream id, pid and metadata fields, so a document can be traced and removed.
No claim of ownership of corpus text is made downstream.
No corpus text or derived weights are published or uploaded without separate authorization (AGENTS.md).
A removal request is handled by excluding the affected locators and refreezing the pool; the project has no automated takedown service.
Rejected examples stay in the restricted rejection ledger without text.
open_risk_accepted_by_operator_decision: Training on crawled web text whose per-page rights are unknown. Recording license_review=approved accepts this for research pretraining only; it is an operator policy decision, not a legal finding.
